notes.title: Winter sale and thematic update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146893/11feacbef815acc1d421a4a40d18c9d10513701b.png[/img]
In honor of the upcoming Christmas, a WINTER update is coming out in Theory of Poltaran, as well as a 50% discount on the game until January 5, 2023!
Happy Christmas!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.content:
- Now the fall of bosses to the ground, after death, has become more realistic
- Updated the interface of health and endurance indicators
- Fixed a bug in which the Mega-Sandpiper either did no damage or inflicted multiple damage
- Added the sound of swimming
- Fixed a bug where NPCs walked outside their area
- Fixed a bug where the player could not move during one of the cutscenes

As well as numerous minor fixes!

notes.title: Global update 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146893/c8d14d324d6928fc9bf6b22d57bc8802b4c5e58f.png[/img]
[b]List of innovations:[/b]
- Added music during boss battles 
- Added translation of the entire game into many languages: Spanish, German, Portuguese, Italian, French, Czech, Ukrainian, Hungarian
- Now, after death, you can upload the save you need 
- Now there are 3D tags on all levels in case of difficulty in passing 
- Now the "RPG" weapon shoots automatically when the LMB key is pressed 
- Now every boss has a health indicator in numbers
- Now a themed box will fall from each boss at death 
- Now each weapon has a description and its characteristics 
- Added audio accompaniment in cutscenes 
- Improved hint interface
- Now, by pressing the "T" key, you can call up a hint 
- Expanded the "Yard" location 
- Now, after dying at the hands of the boss "Bull-like Sample", you appear in his arena 
- Added an intuitive hint when going to the "Selo" level 

[b]Error correction: [/b]
- Fixed a bug where decals could be projected onto NPCs and the main character's weapons 
- Fixed a bug where the Mimic boss could not walk across the entire area of the game location 
- Fixed a bug where the boss "Bull-like Sample" could enter the water 
- Fixed a bug where there was no explosion effect from the "RPG" weapon projectile 
- Fixed a bug where a cigarette was missing from a smoking NPC 
- Fixed a bug where the boss "Mega-kulik" got stuck in buildings 
 
[b]As well as numerous minor changes![/b]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content: - Fixed a bug where crate disappeared after death at the "Yard" location.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
- Fixed getting stuck in objects in the "Yard" location
- Added names of talking characters in subtitles
- Fixed bosses appearing out of place
- The boss of "Mega-Sandpiper" was balanced
- Fixed bosses "Paradoxes"  getting stuck in objects
- Fixed localization of subtitles
